summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload at install time
details: Package advertises itself as a trivial test module (lib/index.js is `export default 'John'`) but its `preinstall` hook runs an obfuscated setup.mjs that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated sibling `math_init.js` on the installer's machine. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, per-function property-map indirection, shuffled string-array with rotation function). Routing execution through a freshly-fetched alternate runtime is an evasion pattern that prevents Node-based tooling from observing the payload's behavior. The package has no documented need for an alternate runtime or a large init module; the only effect of installing it is arbitrary code execution under Bun on the installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
